svg.title: Blueprint 9: ActivityPub S2S Federation, 3-Tier Trust & Cross-Instance Lending
svg.desc: Modern Athenaeum architecture diagram for iqoqo v1.2.0 showing Node Alpha discovery, RSA-2048 Fernet key hygiene, FederationConsent and FEDERATION_HEAD_MODE, outbound Valkey federation pipeline, Node Beta Crimson inbound security perimeter, dedicated federation schema, 3-tier trust matrix, and 4-step cross-instance lending sequence.
svg.text: Blueprint 9: ActivityPub S2S Federation, 3-Tier Trust & Cross-Instance Lending
Server-to-Server ActivityStreams 2.0 • RSA-2048 HTTP Signatures • Dedicated federation Schema • CIDOC CRM Custody

g.text: Server-to-Server (S2S) only — no C2S endpoints; Next.js uses REST/JSON
• RSA-2048 private keys encrypted at rest via symmetric Fernet (SECRET_KEY)
• Publishes publicKeyPem + SHA256:... DER key fingerprints
• Fingerprint pinning & verification surfaced in Admin Settings
• User shelf never federates unless explicitly opted in via /profile
Permits federated discovery & wishlists; blocks physical Item writes at API layer
• Signs POST & Authorized Fetch GET: draft-cavage-http-signatures-12
FEDERATION_ALLOW_LOOPBACK=true permitted strictly for local dev-pair tests
1. Verifies RSA-SHA256 HTTP Signature against actor publicKeyPem
2. ±300s clock-skew replay defense + strict payload_actor == actor_uri check
3. Evaluates local FederationInstance.trust_level (blocked dropped at gate)
4. Sanitizes all inbound bibliographic metadata via bleach.clean()
Auto bibliographic sync (SHACL-validated; local curator locks win)
Direct Follow delivery & Cross-Instance Loans enabled
Enriches local catalog from peer & sends Follow requests;
Peer's own local policy governs loan acceptance
Public catalog discovery only; NO automatic catalog sync
Follow & Loan requests held for manual custodian review
Rejected immediately at HTTP Signature gate
All activities, follows & loan offers dropped silently

svg.text: 4-Step Cross-Instance Lending Sequence (Node Alpha ↔ Node Beta)

g.text: • Borrower discovers public Item on Peer
• Appears as Borrowed on Borrower shelf
